topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I can't even begin to tell you how crazy this is. My grandma's ring, the one she wore every day, the one she said she'd pass down to me, just sitting there in some dusty case in a pawn shop. How did it even get there? Like, who would do that? It's not just a piece of jewelry, it's a part of our family history, of who we are. I mean, I found it, but it's like finding a piece of you in a stranger’s hands. I’m going to get it back, no matter what it takes. This needs to be fixed, and I’m not stopping until it is.
